actual: RCA verified 2026-07-02: SimulationLifecycleScheduler.run_once() only catches DataUnavailableError and RuntimeConfigInvalidError at the per-binding loop. A LiveInferencePreflightError from selection/preflight (strategy_package_model_code_missing for pkg_378...) escaped the per-binding boundary, aborted the whole tick, skipped later eligible MiniQMT/LocalSim bindings, and only landed in background last_result/logs without durable simulation_daily_run failure evidence. Fix must isolate non-fatal per-binding exceptions, persist durable pre-run failure with loud reason/context, continue later bindings, preserve raise_on_error/system-exception semantics, and expose true lifecycle scheduler status fields.
